_about: Every photograph, clip and panorama used on the site. All are real-world captures by the credited photographers, used illustratively: none depicts Firstlight, Kesarnagar or any customer. Licences were read on the source pages on 24 Oct 2026. Raw sources live in assets-src/ (not committed); run `npm run media` to rebuild public/media/.

photos.alt: Looking out from a dim loading bay through an open roller door at a white box truck in daylight.
photos.notes: No people. A phone number and fleet ID on the truck are blurred (redact regions, source pixels).

photos.alt: Silhouetted figures playing cricket on a tree-lined street in low dawn light.
photos.notes: Figures are silhouettes; no identifiable faces. Source page names Mumbai; the site does not claim a location.

photos.alt: A wide city skyline under morning haze, low-rise housing in the foreground and towers on the horizon.
Inside a van loaded with cardboard boxes; the open rear doors frame a suburban road at sunset.
A long distribution-centre aisle between high racks of boxed stock under strip lights.
photos.notes: No people. Carton print illegible at display sizes.

photos.alt: A reach truck carrying a wrapped pallet past numbered storage racks, slightly motion-blurred.
photos.notes: Operator not identifiable (blur). No legible brand on the truck; product cartons blurred.

photos.alt: A dim warehouse aisle between tall shelves, lit by a line of ceiling lamps.
Looking up at lamps, fans and pallet racking in a high-ceilinged warehouse.
A worker, seen from behind, wheeling a tall stack of cartons along a city street.
photos.notes: Face not visible (described as unrecognisable by the source).

photos.alt: Two hands passing a padded parcel from one person to another.
A courier in a hi-vis vest checks parcel labels on the passenger seat of a van; the face is out of frame.
photos.notes: Face out of frame. Labels illegible.

photos.alt: Close-up of the corners of stacked cardboard boxes in soft light.
photos.notes: Small print on one box is illegible at display size.

photos.alt: Head-high stacks of colourful plastic crates outside a market shed.
Empty white plastic crates piled inside a rusted container, lit from an opening above.

videos.alt: Time-lapse-steady shot of the sun rising through haze over a dense city, birds crossing the frame.
videos.notes: Location not stated by the source; none claimed on the site.

videos.alt: A forklift lifts pallets beside towering stacks of empty pallets in a warehouse.
videos.notes: Operator small in frame, not identifiable.

videos.alt: A city skyline seen across the sea at twilight as the lights come on.

panoramas.alt: A 360-degree photograph of an empty warehouse with a concrete floor and arched roof under fluorescent light.
panoramas.notes: Captured 15 May 2020. An empty, disused hall: not a working depot and not a Firstlight site.
